title: PWS ack message
description: Command result published by the device on pws/{device_id}/ack/{cmd_id} (QoS 1, not retained) after it has processed a command. Expired commands, bad signatures, device_id mismatches and replays are dropped silently and never acked, so an ack always refers to a command the device accepted as authentic. The contract page only names the topic; the payload shape here is a proposal recorded in schemas/README.md. Unknown keys are ignored by the server.

id.description: Identifier of the command being acknowledged. Equals the {cmd_id} topic segment.

device_id.description: Publishing device. Optional; the topic already carries it.

type.description: Type of the command being acknowledged, copied from the command so the server can route the ack without a lookup.

ok.description: True when the command was carried out (or, for config, staged and awaiting confirm). False when it was understood but could not be carried out; 'error' then says why.

error.description: Human readable failure reason when ok is false. Null or absent when ok is true.

result.description: Type specific result, for example the connectivity_test report for diag or the number of buckets queued for resync. Left open by the contract.

ts.description: Time the ack was produced, UTC.
